constraints: Write only the four exact assigned proposal files; do not edit questions, goals, checkpoints, hypotheses, knowledge, queues, experiments, or existing proposals.

Return exactly four distinct ideas, not variants. Prefer mechanisms with an explicit public target-dependent observable and decoder or a structural ingredient that could move an exponent; a control or measurement is admissible only when it decisively gates a high-value mechanism.
